locked_requirements: All persistent types are defined only in mode_p_vnext.domain.
Pipeline modules must not define persistent dataclasses or semantic equivalents.
The system has exactly one persistent state graph.
A2 may not modify the A1-owned canonical domain while A1 is completed.

contradicting_evidence.architecture_conflict: Persistent schema authority is implemented in pipeline instead of mode_p_vnext.domain.

contradicting_evidence.persistence_proof: InvalidationRecord is a frozen dataclass with to_dict/from_dict and is embedded in committed invalidation transitions.
contradicting_evidence.architecture_conflict: A persistent transition schema is implemented in pipeline instead of mode_p_vnext.domain.

contradicting_evidence.persistence_proof: PendingNodeWrite is a frozen dataclass written to PENDING.json and bound by the commit manifest.
contradicting_evidence.architecture_conflict: A durable transaction schema is implemented outside mode_p_vnext.domain.

contradicting_evidence.persistence_proof: NodeCacheKey is a frozen dataclass serialized into restart-safe cache records.
contradicting_evidence.architecture_conflict: A durable cache identity schema is implemented outside mode_p_vnext.domain.

contradicting_evidence.persistence_proof: NodeSpec is a frozen dataclass whose descriptor is persisted in RUN.json and bound by graph_digest.
contradicting_evidence.architecture_conflict: The durable graph contract lacks a canonical domain authority.

second_authority_evidence.impact: The repository still exposes executable state, transaction, and invalidation authorities alongside the new A2 graph. Marking them historical in prose does not fail closed.

release_ledger_ownership_conflict.conclusion: A2 cannot move the durable schemas into the sole canonical domain without an out-of-scope modification to a completed predecessor.

verification_observations.summary: Found persistent dataclasses and durable serialization contracts outside mode_p_vnext.domain; architecture invariant failed.

deepseek_v4_flash_advisory.summary: The advisory review independently identified the same section 5.1 violation and agreed that A2 must fail before A1 is reopened.

required_remediation_sequence: Fail A2 under its current exclusive lock and stop the work package.
In a later control-plane round, invalidate completed A1 because canonical persistent schemas are missing from its domain authority.
Re-run A1 to define the canonical persistent graph, acceptance, invalidation, transaction, cache-key, and graph-contract schemas in mode_p_vnext.domain without implementing A2 storage behavior.
Resume A2 only when ReleaseLedger again returns A2; migrate pipeline/runtime behavior to the A1 domain schemas and retire executable legacy state authorities with auditable historical source blobs.
Re-run registered tests, cross-package regressions, authority scans, Evidence validation, and ReleaseLedger audit.
